cards.label: CGSS
cards.text: Chinese General Social Survey: Cross-sectional social attitudes and stratification at the individual/household/community levels. Access: Public application or project-specific rules. Official entry point: https://cgss.ruc.edu.cn/

cards.label: CFPS
cards.text: China Family Panel Studies: Individual–household–community panel suited to family, education, health, and mobility. Access: Register and follow the data-use agreement. Official entry point: https://opendata.pku.edu.cn/dataverse/CFPS

cards.label: CLDS
cards.text: China Labor-force Dynamics Survey: Workers, households, and communities, suited to employment, labor relations, and social insurance. Access: Apply under the provider's rules. Official entry point: https://css.sysu.edu.cn/

cards.label: CHARLS
cards.text: China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study: Longitudinal health, caregiving, and economic data on individuals and households aged 45 and older. Access: Register and follow the data-use agreement. Official entry point: https://charls.charlsdata.com/

cards.label: CHFS
cards.text: China Household Finance Survey: Household assets, liabilities, income, insurance, and consumption. Access: Apply under the survey provider's data rules. Official entry point: https://chfs.swufe.edu.cn/

cards.label: CHNS
cards.text: China Health and Nutrition Survey: Long-term individual, household, and community health/nutrition and socioeconomic data. Access: Obtain under UNC data rules. Official entry point: https://www.cpc.unc.edu/projects/china

cards.label: CEPS
cards.text: China Education Panel Survey: Longitudinal data on middle-school students, parents, teachers, and schools. Access: Register and follow the data-use agreement. Official entry point: https://ceps.ruc.edu.cn/

cards.label: CHIP
cards.text: China Household Income Project: Microdata on income, poverty, distribution, and the labor market. Access: Obtain through research application/agreement. Official entry point: https://cid.cass.cn/

cards.label: CSS
cards.text: Chinese Social Survey: Social structure, public services, living conditions, and attitudes. Access: Follow data-release rules. Official entry point: https://css.cssn.cn/

cards.label: CMDS
cards.text: China Migrants Dynamic Survey: Employment, family, health, and public services among migrants. Access: Often restricted or available through project channels. Official entry point: https://www.nhc.gov.cn/

cards.label: China Population Census
cards.text: National population census and sample surveys: Aggregate/regional measures of population, education, migration, and housing. Access: Public tabulations; confirm separate access for micro samples. Official entry point: https://www.stats.gov.cn/

cards.label: National Bureau of Statistics database
cards.text: Annual national and regional statistics: Prefecture-, city-, and county-level economic, demographic, employment, and public-service indicators. Access: Public tables; record download date and definitions. Official entry point: https://data.stats.gov.cn/

cards.label: China City Statistical Yearbook
cards.text: Annual city-level statistics: Urban economy, construction, public services, environment, and population. Access: Yearbook/database access depends on source. Official entry point: https://www.stats.gov.cn/

cards.label: China Labour Statistical Yearbook
cards.text: Annual labor-market statistics: Regional measures of employment, wages, social insurance, and labor disputes. Access: Yearbook/database access depends on source. Official entry point: https://www.stats.gov.cn/

cards.label: Education statistics
cards.text: Ministry of Education statistics on educational development: Administrative statistics on schools, teachers and students, funding, and progression. Access: Public tabulations; school-level microdata are usually restricted. Official entry point: http://www.moe.gov.cn/

cards.label: China Judgments Online/government public information
cards.text: Public legal and government texts: Observable traces of texts, cases, or policy implementation. Access: Public availability does not imply bulk-reuse rights; follow site rules. Official entry point: https://wenshu.court.gov.cn/

cards.label: Peking University Digital Financial Inclusion Index
cards.text: Regional digital-finance indicators: Provincial, prefectural, and county-level digital-finance development and subdimensions. Access: Verify version, spatial matching, and usage license. Official entry point: https://idf.pku.edu.cn/

cards.label: China household panel/special-topic survey secondary data
cards.text: Special-topic data from academic institutions: Supplementary microdata on specific groups and mechanisms. Access: Verify sampling, years, permissions, and field documentation for each dataset. Official entry point: https://opendata.pku.edu.cn/

cards.label: World Values Survey
cards.text: World Values Survey: Cross-national comparisons of attitudes, values, and social trust. Access: Register, download, and use survey weights. Official entry point: https://www.worldvaluessurvey.org/

cards.label: ISSP
cards.text: International Social Survey Programme: Cross-national, modular social attitudes and institutional evaluations. Access: Use according to archive rules. Official entry point: https://issp.org/

cards.label: Research-question level
cards.text: First classify the study as descriptive, associational, mechanistic, or causal; do not make claims stronger than the design supports.

cards.label: Unit of analysis
cards.text: Specify whether variables are at the individual, household, firm, community, or regional level; avoid cross-level interpretations.

cards.label: Temporal ordering
cards.text: Mark measurement times for X, M, and Y; cross-sectional data cannot establish ordering.

cards.label: Sample flow
cards.text: Report initial N, every exclusion rule, loss due to missingness, and final N.

cards.label: Weights
cards.text: With survey data, consult the codebook to determine whether individual/household/longitudinal weights should be used.

cards.label: Missingness
cards.text: Report missingness and handling separately for core variables; do not assume listwise deletion is unbiased.

cards.label: Outliers
cards.text: Pre-specify trimming, winsorization, log/IHS transformations, and thresholds, then conduct sensitivity comparisons.

cards.label: Reference groups
cards.text: Label reference groups for categorical variables; report combined predictions for interactions rather than reading coefficients alone.

cards.label: Standard errors
cards.text: Choose clustered or complex-survey variance estimation according to the sampling, treatment-assignment, and repeated-observation levels.

cards.label: Common support
cards.text: For matching, weighting, and causal models, check comparable support ranges for treatment and control groups.

cards.label: Pre-trends
cards.text: For any DiD/event study, show pre-treatment coefficients, confidence intervals, and the specific window.

cards.label: Placebos
cards.text: Use unaffected times, outcomes, or pseudo-treatment groups to test design specificity.

cards.label: Multiple testing
cards.text: For multiple outcomes/groups, distinguish exploratory from confirmatory analyses and, when necessary, adjust or control the FDR.

cards.label: Heterogeneity
cards.text: Subgroups must have theoretical justification; report interactions, group sample sizes, and common support.

cards.label: Reproducibility
cards.text: Preserve raw-data versions, codebooks, cleaning scripts, analysis scripts, and random seeds.

cards.label: Ethics and permissions
cards.text: Record data agreements, de-identification, minimization of sensitive variables, and access conditions for nonpublic materials.
